subject: Early repurchase credit and channel split for AWS Private Offer
messages:
From: Jeanne Porter <jeanne.porter@acme-corp.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer — early repurchase credit and reseller split

Hi Ben,

Quick question on the draft private offer your team shared: our legal/procurement team asked whether you support an "early repurchase" credit — essentially if we replace a 36-month commit after 12 months for a new vendor consolidation, can we get a partial credit for the remaining unused commit? Acme is trying to build that carve-out into the SOW so finance can sign.

Second piece — we route through CloudResell for EMEA and want to confirm how you typically split the channel margin on AWS private offers when a reseller brings the relationship. Is the reseller margin carved out of the private-offer discount, or do you apply a fixed reseller fee on top?

Attached is the PO draft (we highlighted the clause). Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept an early repurchase credit and a recommended channel split for CloudResell? We need the language for the SOW by EOD Friday.

Thanks — Jeanne
Jeanne Porter
Sr. Procurement Manager, Acme Corp

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jeanne Porter <jeanne.porter@acme-corp.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:29:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer — early repurchase credit and reseller split

Hi Jeanne — thanks for the note and the PO draft. Short answers up front: we can support a structured early repurchase credit in certain cases (needs deal approval + finance runback), and we have two standard approaches for reseller margins on private offers. I'll loop in Jordan and Kim for the margin mechanics and the exact wording.

High-level: 1) Early repurchase credit: possible, typically handled as a pro-rated credit against remaining committed value with a small admin fee. We usually require the replacement to be an approved buy-down scenario and sign off from finance. 2) Reseller split: we can either (A) reduce the private-offer discount by the reseller fee (so the net list price paid is split), or (B) pay the reseller a separate commission/voucher outside the private-offer pricing; both are viable depending on customer and partner preference.

Jordan / Kim — can you run a quick margin workback for a 36mo, $1.2M commit where Acme repurchases at month 12 (i.e., 24 months unused) and CloudResell expects ~18% net margin in EMEA? Attach any suggested SOW language. Jeanne — I copied procurement on the PO; we can aim to get you wording by EOD Friday.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer — early repurchase credit and reseller split (margin workback attached)

Ben / Jordan / Vivek — I did a quick workback and attached margin_workback_bencalc.xlsx. Key assumptions and recommendation: 

- Scenario: 36mo $1.2M commit (monthly burn = $33,333) with repurchase at month 12 -> remaining committed value = $800,000.
- Our typical early-repurchase credit: 70% of remaining committed value is eligible (we hold a 30% administrative/retention buffer). That would imply a customer credit of $560k in value, delivered as a credit against future Redwood services or a partial refund per SOW language. Finance prefers credit (not cash) for accounting simplicity.
- Reseller margin mechanics (CloudResell 18% target): Option A (carve-out): apply reseller margin as a percentage of the gross reseller-eligible net (i.e., reduce private-offer discount such that reseller margin is embedded) — effective to keep marketplace invoice flows simple. Option B (commission voucher): pay CloudResell a 18% commission on net recognized revenue post-credit via separate invoice/voucher.

Recommendation: Use Option B for this deal. Rationale: Acme wants a clean, auditable SOW showing credit mechanics and separate partner compensation. Option B keeps the private offer gross discount intact and prevents downstream billing confusion in EMEA (marketplace invoice will match the private-offer amount; CloudResell receives a separate commission). Finance flagged that a separate commission is also simpler from a tax/reporting perspective in EMEA.

Suggested SOW language (draft):
"If Customer replaces or terminates the private-offer commitment within the first 24 months, Redwood will apply an early-repurchase credit equal to 70% of the remaining committed value. Credits will be applied to future Redwood services during a 12-month redemption window. Partner compensation to CloudResell Partners will be delivered as a separate commission equal to 18% of Net Recognized Revenue (post-credit), invoiced and paid within 30 days of Redwood recognition."

I attached the workback + a short example tab demonstrating the calculation. If we move forward with Option B we need to confirm partner invoicing details (billing contact + TIN) and include a call-out in the private-offer notes.

Kimberly Park
Director, Deal Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jeanne Porter <jeanne.porter@acme-corp.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, partners@cloudresell.io
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer — early repurchase credit and reseller split

Hi Jeanne — looping back with our recommended approach and draft SOW language. Apologies for the slightly longer timeline; wanted to confirm with Deal Ops and Finance.

Summary proposal (high level):
- Early repurchase credit: 70% of remaining committed value (admin buffer 30%), credit applied to future Redwood services within 12 months. Finance will treat this as a credit balance on Acme's Redwood account.
- Partner compensation: pay CloudResell Partners an 18% commission on Net Recognized Revenue after the credit is applied. Commission will be issued as a separate invoice/voucher; we will not compress the reseller margin into the private-offer discount for this deal.

Draft SOW clause (copying Kim's wording):
"If Customer replaces or terminates the private-offer commitment within the first 24 months, Redwood will apply an early-repurchase credit equal to 70% of the remaining committed value. Credits will be applied to future Redwood services during a 12-month redemption window. Partner compensation to CloudResell Partners will be delivered as a separate commission equal to 18% of Net Recognized Revenue (post-credit), invoiced and paid within 30 days of Redwood recognition."

Next steps: 
1) Jeanne — confirm Acme accepts credit-as-credit (not cash) and that the 70%/30% split is acceptable.
2) If yes, please provide CloudResell billing contact and TIN for the commission.
3) We'll update the private-offer note and attach the margin_workback_bencalc.xlsx to the deal record (HubSpot link below).

HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/DEAL-ACME-2026-03
Drive workback: https://drive.company/acme/margin_workback

If you want a quick call to run through the numbers, Jordan and I are available this afternoon.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
